caseName: United Air Lines, Inc. v. Public Utilities Commission
caseNameFull: United Air Lines, Inc. v. Public Utilities Commission of California and Western Air Lines, Inc. v. Public Utilities Commission of California
attorneys: Oscar A. Trippet and Paul M. Godehn for appellant in No. 464., Hugh W. Darling for appellant in No. 465. Everett C. MtKeage for appellee..

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motions to dismiss are. granted and the appeals are dismissed for the want of a substantial- federal question.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Burton are of the opinion probable jurisdiction should be noted.
